CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid templates for ready-to-run Minecraft modpack servers by PaddyGameTV: **All the Mods 10** and **All the Mods 11**. Each container downloads the newest official server pack from CurseForge on first start, and a new image is built automatically for every new server pack version. A free CurseForge API key is required. Support: open an issue in the matching GitHub repository (docker-allthemods10 / docker-allthemods11).
